_meta.description: Buildable structures and vehicle parameters, owned by Member 2. Costs are placeholder starting balance values - tune during Day 16 (Oct 11) balance pass.

structures.name: Solar Array
structures.effect: Increases power generation, scaled by site illumination_pct.

structures.name: Water Extractor
structures.effect: Increases water production, scaled by site hydrogen_ppm.

structures.name: Greenhouse Module
structures.effect: Increases food production; consumes power and water.

structures.name: Radiation Shielding Wall
structures.effect: Reduces crew radiation dose accumulation rate.

structures.name: Habitat Extension
structures.effect: Increases crew capacity and reduces base stress accumulation.

structures.name: Comms Relay
structures.effect: Unlocks early-warning for solar-particle-event radiation spikes.

rover.notes: discovery_chance rolls against unexplored tiles near the site for water/resource finds.
